_comment: Graphiti embed-text lane — 4096-d, symmetric, DIMENSION-LOCKED to the Neo4j vector index. NVIDIA nv-embed-v1 ONLY, no cross-provider fallback: Gemini's gemini-embedding-001 tops out at 3072-d and cannot match this index, and a silent wrong-dimension fallback would corrupt vectors rather than fail loudly. Portkey still buys retry-on-transient-error around the one target.
